summary: Stephen Kalonzo Musyoka is a former Vice President of Kenya (2008–2013) and party leader of the Wiper Democratic Movement. Having held numerous senior cabinet portfolios spanning foreign affairs and education across four decades, Musyoka has remained a key opposition principal within the Azimio coalition, facing parliamentary and investigative queries regarding land ownership adjacent to the National Youth Service in Yatta.
introduction: Stephen Kalonzo Musyoka (born 24 December 1953) has had a long career in public administration, serving as Vice President under Mwai Kibaki following the 2007-2008 post-election crisis. Regarded as a senior statesman with a strong regional base in Ukambani, Musyoka has championed constitutional reform and judicial independence. The primary public land inquiry associated with his name centered on allegations regarding his 200-acre Yatta farm parcel bordering the National Youth Service (NYS) camp in Machakos County; in August 2021, the Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) Land Fraud Unit cleared him of irregular acquisition, confirming lawful title acquisition dating back to 1994.
